newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Wuhan Plastics '96 net profit up 88 pct.
newsitem.headline: Wuhan Plastics '96 net profit up 88 pct.

text.p: China's Wuhan Plastics Industrial Group Co Ltd said on Monday its 1996 net profit surged 88 percent to 21.88 million yuan from 11.64 million yuan in 1995.
Sharp gains came from an 11.53 percent increase in sales and investment in China's stock markets, the company statement published in Monday's Shenzhen-based Securities Times said.
Sales in 1996 were worth 263.35 million yuan, up from 236.12 million yuan in 1995, while profit from equity investment reached 5.59 million yuan in 1996, the statement said.
Earnings per share in 1996 were 0.44 yuan, up 91 percent from 0.23 yuan a year earlier, it said.
The company said it planned to issue a 1996 dividend payment along with a 1997 interim dividend, adding the plan needed the approval of shareholders.
The firm, based in Wuhan, capital of central Hubei province, mainly produces plastic parts, such as fuel tanks, for automobiles, and for household electrical appliances.
It listed 13.74 million A shares on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange last December.
